config.goldentweaks.astralsorcery_focal_: Astral Sorcery Focal Point Column (drawn by GoldenTweaks)

Astral Sorcery's own focal point column relies on a custom core shader and renders no pixels in some modpacks. When enabled, GoldenTweaks draws the column with a vanilla render type instead. Disable to leave it entirely to Astral Sorcery.
config.goldentweaks.balance.academy.magi: Final damage bonus per step (see the option above). 0.1 means 10%.

When holding Silent Gear equipment that carries Magic Attack (magic_damage), the highest value of the main and off hand increases the final damage dealt by AcademyCraft skills. Defaults to +10% per 5 magic attack (tune the two options below). Disable to leave skill damage untouched by equipment.
How many points of magic attack make up one step. Default 5, i.e. every 5 magic attack adds one step of bonus damage.
config.goldentweaks.balance.academy.skil: When enabled, skills that break blocks on their own (railgun, mine ray, directed blast, ...) are subject to FTB Chunks protection just like normal block breaking: they cannot break protected blocks inside another team's claim. Disable to restore the mod's original behavior.
config.goldentweaks.balance.ae2cs.max_sp: Upper bound on the effective speed multiplier of the ae2cs Entropy Variation Reaction Chamber. Each speed card doubles both the per-tick energy cost and the processing speed; too many cards make the instantaneous energy demand high enough that the machine stalls (progress bar freezes, no output), so it is clamped to one speed card (2x) by default. Set to 16 to disable the limit and restore the mod's original behavior.
config.goldentweaks.balance.astralsorcer: Upper bound on the perk points a player can earn in Astral Sorcery. The mod defaults to 30 (and its own config caps out at 100), which is not enough to fill the perk tree; this defaults to 364, the total number of nodes in the tree, so every perk can eventually be taken. It only raises the cap: the effective value is the larger of this option and Astral Sorcery's own config.

Replaces Astral Sorcery's perk level experience curve (150 + 100x1.2^k) with a monotonically increasing power curve: 0.99 x k^1.5. The cost only ever rises and has no hard segments; levels 1-364 total about 1,000,000 exp (the original already needs about 2.6e12 to reach level 100), and every level is far below the original formula. Disable to restore the original curve.
config.goldentweaks.balance.createoreexc: Master switch. When enabled, every additional machine owned by a different player on the same ore vein grants all machines on that vein the speed and yield bonuses below. Disable to turn every sharing bonus off (machine owners are still recorded).
Upper bound on the double output chance. Default 1.00, i.e. at most 100%.
Search radius (in blocks) used by the Golden Vein Finder, which reports vein coordinates in chat when used. Default 2500, range 0-10000.
Fraction of processing time removed for every additional machine owned by a different player on the same vein. Default 0.20 (20% faster), limited by the vein speed floor.
Lower bound on how far processing time can be shortened, as a fraction of the original recipe. Default 0.50: no amount of sharing can cut a cycle below 50% of its original length.
Chance of a double output for every additional machine owned by a different player on the same vein. Default 0.20 (20% more), limited by the double output cap.
config.goldentweaks.balance.disable_adva: Disables similar Practical Thaumaturgy items in favor of GoldenTweaks-maintained versions.
config.goldentweaks.balance.evolved_meka: Global multiplier for Evolved Mekanism solar generators. Affects all tiers' power output.
config.goldentweaks.balance.haggler_max_: Maximum number of item costs that the Haggler Ring from Iron's Jewelry can reduce
Maximum percentage of the original price that the Haggler Ring from Iron's Jewelry can reduce the price to
config.goldentweaks.balance.mekanism.com: Output percentage of Mekanism solar panels, wind generators and Evolved Mekanism solar panels when placed inside a Compact Machines dimension, where they ignore time of day and sky obstruction. 100 means full peak output. Solar neutron activators are unaffected and always run at full efficiency.
config.goldentweaks.balance.mekanism.tra: Upper bound on how many Mekanism in-transit stacks are simulated as flowing toward a single destination per path calculation. Huge-stack containers (e.g. Sophisticated Storage barrels with stack upgrade omega holding millions per slot) can make this set grow into the thousands and freeze the server tick until it OOMs. Stacks beyond the cap are only left out of the insert prediction (no items are dropped). 0 disables the limit.

Upper bound on how many item stacks a single Mekanism Logistical Transporter block may hold in transit at once. When a destination cannot accept items, stacks pile up in the pipes (observed: 1108-3218 on one block) and each one adds to the per-tick path/insert simulation until the server hangs. Once reached, the transporter refuses new stacks and the backlog is pushed back upstream. 0 disables the limit.
config.goldentweaks.balance.mio_icif.com: Output percentage of MIO-ICIF solar generators when placed inside a Compact Machines dimension, where they ignore time of day and sky obstruction and always use daytime peak output. 100 means 100% of the daytime peak; any value above 0 is allowed.

Output percentage of MIO-ICIF wind generators and wind kinetic generators when placed inside a Compact Machines dimension. Wind is always calculated as the clear-weather wind of the highest outdoor position; 100 means that baseline output, and any value above 0 is allowed.
config.goldentweaks.balance.recycler_fac: Allow Mekanism Extras recycler factories to use Stack upgrades.
config.goldentweaks.balance.remove_thaum: Removes the yellow highlight frame from incomplete research in the Thaumonomicon map.
config.goldentweaks.balance.thaumcraft.a: How many recently matched arcane recipes are remembered to avoid scanning the full recipe list on every craft. Reduces arcane workbench lag; 0 disables the cache.
Whether the arcane workbench can craft vanilla (non-arcane) recipes.
config.goldentweaks.balance.thaumcraft.d: When enabled, pure aura nodes no longer convert nearby tainted land into the magical forest biome.
When enabled, sinister (dark) aura nodes no longer convert nearby biomes into the eerie biome.

When enabled, the tainted land biome no longer expands through taint fibres, flux goo, taint creatures and thrown taint. Biome conversion caused by aura nodes is controlled separately by the node options below.
When enabled, tainted aura nodes no longer convert nearby biomes into the tainted land biome.
config.goldentweaks.balance.thaumcraft.e: Which entities the Earth Shock spell damages. OnlyLiving: living entities only. ExceptItemXp: everything except item entities and experience orbs. AllEntity: everything, the port's default behavior.
config.goldentweaks.balance.thaumcraft.h: When enabled, Thaumic Horizons rifts devour and destroy nearby blocks, as the port does by default. When disabled a rift only crafts and keeps its visuals.
When enabled, hungry aura nodes devour and destroy nearby blocks, as the port does by default. When disabled they only drain vis.
config.goldentweaks.balance.thaumcraft.s: When enabled, golems stop pathfinding and stay at their home position: every job that used to require walking to its target (harvest, lumber, gather, fill, empty, sorting, use, liquid, essentia) is done from home instead, with a fixed one-second search interval. This also prevents golems from getting stuck when they cannot reach a target, and fixes gather golems holding items without depositing them into the home container. Guard and butcher cores rely on moving to chase targets and are unaffected.
config.goldentweaks.balance.thaumcraft.t: Caches crucible recipes looked up by hash to avoid scanning the full recipe list on every use.
Caches item aspect (object tags) lookups to avoid recomputing derived aspects on every call.
Caches research item lookups by key to avoid iterating every research category on each call.
Automatically cycles through aspect source item pages. Manual mouse-wheel paging is unaffected.
Thaumonomicon Aspect Source Items Per Frame
Number of items scanned per frame when hovering an aspect for the first time. Higher values load faster but may cause frame-time spikes.
Automatic aspect source page interval in milliseconds.
config.goldentweaks.balance.thaumicbases: When items are piped into an alchemical furnace (including Thaumic Bases' advanced one), the fuel slot is offered first, so anything that can burn is routed into the fuel slot instead of the input slot and everything else falls through to the input slot. config.goldentweaks.emi_fast_search.comm: Replaces EMI's multi-layer set building and full item scan with a gram inverted index and bitset evaluation. Disable to restore EMI's original search.
config.goldentweaks.emi_skip_vanilla_sea: Skips building vanilla's suffix array for EMI's search, saving seconds of reload time and tens of MB of scratch memory. Only applies while Fast EMI Search is enabled.
config.goldentweaks.emi_defer_search_ind: Builds the tooltip search index on a background thread after the reload finishes, so entering a world is much faster. Until it is ready, `$` searches do not include tooltip matches.

tc.research_page.GT_BRAIN_JAR_RESEARCHER:
The brain within the jar consumes more than mere experience. Thoughts, memories, inspirations, and even those ideas that never quite managed to take shape leave faint echoes within it. Properly guided, this restless mind can piece together answers from those echoes, pouring its accumulated wisdom into unfinished research notes and carrying you across the final steps of the deduction.
Once this research is complete, hold an unfinished research note and right-click the Brain in the Jar to ask it to complete the work for you. It will spend its own stored experience first. Should that prove insufficient, it will draw the remainder from your own experience. The deeper the research, the greater the price.
If the combined knowledge of you and the brain is still not enough, however, nothing will be taken. Perhaps it, too, understands a simple truth: when there is not enough knowledge to think with, forcing an answer will only lead to madness.
tc.research_page.GT_CRIMSON_RITES.1:
Blood. Filth. Fragments of ritual records so worn that their original meaning has nearly vanished. These things were never meant to be gathered beneath the same Infusion Matrix. Yet if arranged according to the surviving fragments, they may be enough to recreate a crimson rite long since buried by time.
No one knows what those rites were meant to summon. The remaining records preserve only a single warning: the gate was opened once.
And now, you possess the means to knock upon it again.
tc.research_page.GT_INFUSION_INTERCEPTER:
Between the moments of an Infusion ritual, you discovered an apparatus that does not belong to any conventional school of Arcane study — the Infusion Interceptor. It does not cast spells. Instead, it intercepts the ritual itself, binding the flow of arcane power that once required a wizard's constant attention within a cold and silent vessel.
Place it 3 to 10 blocks beneath the Runic Matrix, and the Interceptor will recognize the Matrix and its pedestals on its own. It will search the 13×13×3 space below for containers of Essentia, drawing forth whatever is required as quietly as though the Matrix had never asked anyone for it.
Once the offering is placed upon the central pedestal, the ritual will begin by itself. No wand. No incantation. No need to touch those dangerous runes ever again.

More unsettling still, the Interceptor appears capable of taking upon itself a portion of the 'uncertainty' inherent to an Infusion ritual. Recipes that would once have given even seasoned thaumaturges pause become strangely quiet in its presence.
Once all required Essentia has been gathered, the Interceptor will claim every offering upon the pedestals at once, completing the Infusion in a single instant. There is no lengthy incantation, no gradual build-up of the ritual, and no discernible moment between beginning and completion.
Some believe that what lies within the Interceptor is not merely arcane data, but a kind of 'memory of the ritual' itself. Thus, even when its master has departed this world, it continues its work — like a tireless scribe, completing unfinished rites in the hours when no one is watching.
tc.research_page.GT_PRIMORDIAL_REPLICATI:
A Primordial Pearl is no ordinary jewel, but a fragment of complete law left behind at the world's beginning. It cannot be manufactured conventionally, though a related primordial structure can be induced to recreate it.
Place a Primordial Nodule at the center of an Infusion altar and surround it with a Balanced Shard, Nether Star, Void Seed, and Echo Shard. Feed the ritual all six primal Essentia together with Magic and Eldritch influence, and the nodule sheds its corrupted shell before crystallizing into a Primordial Pearl.
This is not creation from nothing. It is the act of forcing a broken structure of creation to remember its original shape.
tc.research_page.GT_RUNED_TABLET.1:
Those peculiar devotees appear to have misplaced an important runed tablet. Curiously, the traces they left behind are not without meaning. As an experienced thaumaturge, you soon recognize the hidden correspondences woven between their runes.
Rearrange them according to their secret affinities, engrave the resonant runes upon a single tablet, and awaken the connections sleeping within the stone with arcane power. Thus may a Runed Tablet be fashioned—a vessel capable of bearing several powers at once.
Perhaps the devotees did not lose these tablets after all. Perhaps they simply had no further use for them.
tc.research_page.GT_SHARD_ALCHEMY.1:
A shard may look like little more than the remains of a broken crystal, yet it preserves an exceptionally pure structural memory. With a suitable seed and the correct Essentia, a crucible can persuade that memory to grow into a different shard.
This method covers Thaumcraft's six primal shards and balanced shard, as well as Forbidden Magic's taint and seven deadly sin shards. Even distant stars obey the same principle: a Spectrum Star Fragment, immersed in Cosmic and Crystal Essentia, condenses into Celestial Thaumaturgy's Meteorite Fragment.
The following pages record every shard alchemy formula discovered so far.
tc.research_page.GT_THAUMIC_MICROSCOPY.1:
As your command of research approaches mastery, the indistinct halos within the Thaumometer finally resolve into finer layers. A container is no longer merely a whole with aspects of its own; through overlapping arcane impressions, you can distinguish the unique resonance left by every item held within it.
After completing this research, scanning a container with the Thaumometer also identifies all of its contents that have not yet been recorded. Identical items are analyzed only once, so the size of a stack adds no needless burden to the observation.
tc.research_page.GT_THAUMIC_MICROSCOPY.2:
This method of observation can also penetrate the storage media used by Applied Energistics and QIO systems. Scanning a dropped AE2 storage cell, NeoECOAE storage matrix, or Mekanism QIO Drive gradually reveals every item stored within it. Scanning an AE2 Drive, an ExtendedAE Extended Drive, a NeoECOAE storage matrix drive, or a QIO Drive Array performs the same examination upon every installed storage medium.
Large storage media may contain thousands of distinct items. To prevent so much information from striking the mind at once, the Thaumometer spreads the analysis over time. You need not keep watching the target; each new discovery is entered into your research records as the examination proceeds.
tc.research_page.GT_UITIMATE_INGOT.1:
Ten spellweave ingots, ten incompatible essences. Each carries the echo of a different law, and none was ever meant to surrender its nature to another. Yet you have conceived a thought bordering on arrogance: if these alien powers were cast into a single ritual, could they be forged into a substance beyond their individual boundaries?
The answer appears to be yes—at least once the Spectral Shard enters the equation. It behaves like a tiny core from somewhere beyond the known realms, capable of containing those conflicting essences within an extraordinarily unstable Infusion.
And so the ten forces cease their struggle. They fall silent within a single piece of metal. What remains is an ingot belonging to no single law, and perhaps to no single world.
You call it the Ultimate Ingot.
As for which realm it truly belongs to... perhaps that is the part most deserving of further study.
During your studies of the Arcane Bath, you caught a glimpse of a truth that was never meant to be seen. From that revelation came a peculiar elixir known as Pure Tears — a liquid said to be untouched even by the Warp itself.
Drink it, and every distortion clinging to your being will fade as though it had never existed. Permanent Warp, temporary Warp, even the tenacious stains that cling like an obsession—all shall be washed away.
The ancient formula demanded a price from those who dared to drink it. The modern recipe has removed that price from the cup. All that remains is the draught, and the quiet moment in which your soul remembers how to be still.
Yet purity should not be accepted lightly. There are secrets that reveal themselves only to the distorted, and when the Warp is gone, something besides madness may vanish with it.
